items.title: Gene Bertoncini interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001
items.q: And one time John Williams came to New York to do a movie called... he had written, the contractor thought, a very difficult part for me and Jay.

ctx.x: Yeah. So when you’d come to the studio for a date, you would not have seen the music beforehand is that right?
Not really, no. A couple of times the contractor knew it was very difficult music. And one time John Williams came to New York to do a movie called — well John Williams came to New York.
